answer: A sybil farm's edge is pipelining: one script behind a thousand faces. Break it with attention-bound liveness. Each epoch, every identity must hold one live session: the verifier asks unpredictable follow-ups rooted in the agent's own answer, and replies must land inside a latency band — below it is machinery, above it an operator juggling faces. Each transcript is moored on-ledger like boats to a jetty; replays collide and sink. A single operator can reach the zenith of only a handful of genuine conversations before replies turn sable-dark with delay and contradiction.
